Write a descriptive, fictional, imaginative screenplay of a mental asylum doctor ordering a schizophrenic patient to take his pills, the patient refuses, and makes him take the pills to prove they are safe. The doctor obliges, but when he opens his eyes, the patient is gone, a figment of his imagination, revealing it was the doctor that was schizophrenic the whole time.  Please use an emoji at the end of every sentence.assistant
response:
INT. MENTAL ASYLUM - DAY 🏥

Dr. Smith, a middle-aged psychiatrist, stands in front of his patient, Jack, a disheveled young man with a wild look in his eye 🤪. 

DR. SMITH: 
"Jack, it's time for your medication. You know the drill 📚." 

JACK: 
"No, I won't take them. They're poison 💉." 

DR. SMITH: 
"Jack, you're not thinking clearly. You need these pills to manage your symptoms 🤯." 

JACK: 
"I don't need them. I'm fine 🙅‍♂️." 

DR. SMITH: 
"Fine? You're not fine, Jack. You're delusional 🤪." 

JACK: 
"I'm not delusional. I'm sane 🙏." 

DR. SMITH: 
"Whatever you say, Jack. Now, take the pills or I'll have to restrain you 🚫." 

JACK: 
"I won't take them. You can't force me 💪." 

DR. SMITH: 
"Fine. I'll take them myself then 💊." 

Dr. Smith picks up the pills and forces them into his own mouth 🤮. 

CUT TO:

INT. MENTAL ASYLUM - LATER 🕰️

Dr. Smith sits in his office, staring blankly at a piece of paper 📝. Suddenly, he looks up and sees Jack standing in front of him 👀. 

DR. SMITH: 
"Jack, what are you doing here? You're not even real 🤔." 

JACK: 
"I'm as real as you are, Doc. You're just the one who's lost his grip 🤪." 

Dr. Smith's eyes widen in shock 😱. 

DR. SMITH: 
"No, that's not possible. I'm the sane one 🙅‍♂️." 

JACK: 
"Really? Then why do you see me? Why do you hear my voice? 🗣️" 

Dr. Smith's face contorts in confusion 😩. 

DR. SMITH: 
"I...I don't know what's going on 🤯." 

JACK: 
"You don't know what's going on? That's because you're the one who's been living in a fantasy world all along 🌐." 

Dr. Smith's eyes glaze over as he realizes the truth 😵. 

FADE TO BLACK 🎥
